discourse.excerpt: So, this raft called body which is the only means of getting across the sea of samsara (worldly life), has to be kept in good trim.
discourse.theme: The body is the raft that carries us across the sea of worldly life — keep it in good trim with devotion, morality and love.
discourse.title: The human raft

reflection: Swami says the body is the only raft for crossing the sea of worldly life, so it must be kept in good trim — and devotion and morality quieten the mind and help even bodily processes. Today, care for your raft: eat simply, move gently, and rest the mind in the Name. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 4, 14 Dec 1964)
seva_nudge: Check in on someone unwell today — a call, a cooked meal, or a ride to an appointment — and help keep their raft in good trim too.
